budget.scope: Returned agent and judge usage at dated standard API prices. Conservative reservations before requests; SDK retries disabled by experiment adapters. Stops on unpriced usage or failed provider calls. Excludes Signals, hosting, taxes and unreturned charges. This is not an account billing cap.

interpretation_limit: Small selected-case pilot, not a population reliability estimate. Repeated trials remain grouped by case. SE describes variation across complete case means only. Report paired outcomes and inspect failures; do not select a winner from noise. Coverage mode changes evidence breadth as well as the coverage policy.
